info.name: Synaplan Integration
info.summary: AI-powered document summarization, translation, knowledge base, and chat
info.description:
Bring Synaplan's AI capabilities directly into owncloud.online:
- Summarize documents with one click - Translate files to multiple languages - Add to Knowledge — vectorize files into the AI knowledge base - Research Chat — AI assistant with knowledge group and model selection, optional personal memories, and live status (model, language, image/video) - Configurable answer language — set a default and optionally follow each user's interface language - Optional per-user Synaplan accounts with an "Activate AI" consent gate
Requires a running Synaplan instance and API key.
info.author: Synaplan
